results.name: All five resources can be gathered on contact, from hexes you own
results.evidence:
wood: 3->5 (+2) in ONE frame on contact — item 216, hex 10 (2 pips, 13 items, 11 left), hex already ours
brick: 3->5 (+2) in ONE frame on contact — item 96, hex 4 (5 pips, 22 items, 20 left), hex claimed with 1 roads + a settlement
wool: 2->3 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 120, hex 5 (3 pips, 16 items, 15 left), hex already ours
wheat: 2->3 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 192, hex 8 (2 pips, 13 items, 12 left), hex already ours
ore: 3->4 (+1) in ONE frame on contact — item 144, hex 6 (3 pips, 16 items, 15 left), hex already ours

results.name: The hex number means two things: how many items it holds and how fast they come back
results.evidence:
5-pip hex 4 (brick): 22 items (declared 22), all 22 swept in 13 contacts -> exhausted=true, back in 38s of 38s = 0.579 items/s sustained
1-pip hex 1 (wool): 10 items (declared 10), all 10 swept in 10 contacts -> exhausted=true, back in 64s of 64s = 0.156 items/s sustained
more items on the better hex: true (22 vs 10) · faster regrowth: true (38s vs 64s) · 3.71x sustained supply
no swing speed involved: every item came off in a single frame of contact

results.name: All three development cards work (Knight, Road Building, Victory Point)
A hex you own nothing next to yields absolutely nothing
results.evidence:
hex 3 (wheat) has no building of anyone's on it
stood on it for 3s (gained 0) then walked over all 10 of its items: gained 0 resources in total
the field is untouched: 10/10 items still standing (nothing was consumed and thrown away)
2 "blocked" events told the player why
then a settlement went up on corner 15: playerOwnsTile=true, canGatherTile=true, and the very next contact gave +1 wheat
